verdict.rationale: monday.com's marketing pages say its AI agents can 'automate status updates and performance reports on a set schedule' and 'spot risks and progress gaps'. Agents can also be @mentioned or assigned items and reply with statuses, which covers AI-drafted status updates on demand or on a schedule. The evidence is only short marketing copy, with no documentation of how drafts are built from recent board activity. Missing for 10: detailed docs on generating updates from recent activity or a selected project or initiative, a description of the review and edit step before posting, and independent or hands-on confirmation.
